name: Amazon
desc:
Selling Partner Support (SP-S) Specialist, Connect With a Specialist | $16.05 to $28.07/hr | Inbound Phone, Chat, and Email Escalations, No Sales Expected
Company: Amazon
Industry: Customer Service

What Your Day Will Look Like:
You'll be the expert that Amazon sellers reach when their problem couldn't be fixed through regular support. These are small business owners and merchants who sell on Amazon, and they need someone who will dig until they find the answer. You'll log in, check for system updates, and then work phone, chat, and email contacts, sometimes at the same time. Some issues are quick account questions. Others take real detective work, like reading past case history, finding the root cause, and building a fix when there's no step-by-step guide. You'll write clear notes on every case, send recap emails, and flag bigger problems to the program team so they can be fixed for everyone. This isn't a scripted job. You'll learn something new on almost every contact.

Soft Skills
- Curiosity and willingness to dig deeper
- Empathy and patience
- Clear written communication
- Staying calm when there's no easy answer
- Teaching yourself new things quickly
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter. Expect typing, grammar, behavioral, and internet speed assessments.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: 1+ year of customer support or contact center experience
Preferred Experience: 2+ years of customer or account support, supporting e-commerce sellers, merchants, or small business owners, investigating complex issues using case history, and working independently in a remote job

Required Skills:
- Fluent English, spoken and written
- Computer troubleshooting, MS Office, and web browsers
- Handling phone, chat, and email contacts at the same time
- Able to stay past the end of a shift to finish an active contact
- Strong research and problem solving

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has call center or customer support experience and wants a bigger challenge
- Has sold online, run a small business, or helped business customers
- Likes solving puzzles that don't have a clear answer
- Writes clear, complete notes and emails

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Wants a scripted job with a step-by-step guide for every call
- Needs to log off at the exact same time every day
- Prefers lots of formal training before working with customers
- Struggles with juggling phone, chat, and email at once
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Escalated customer support
- Phone, chat, and email support
- Root cause analysis
- Case research and documentation
- E-commerce or online seller support
- Account support
- Computer troubleshooting
- Microsoft Office
- Critical thinking
- Process improvement

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer support experience across phone, chat, and email.
- A seller has contacted support three times and nothing has worked. How would you start?
- How do you check that information from a tool or knowledge base is actually correct?
- Tell us about a time you solved a problem with no clear answer. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you spotted a problem that kept happening and raised it. What was it, who did you tell, and what changed?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16.05 to $28.07/hr. Starting pay depends on experience, qualifications, and location.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: EAP, mental health support, medical advice line, and 401(k) matching starting Day 1. Full details at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: Fully remote, open to most states except New York and California. Calls don't always end when your shift does. If you're helping a seller at the end of your shift, you're expected to finish before logging off, and this happens often. Most learning happens on live contacts, not in long formal training. Earlier Amazon roles included typing, grammar, behavioral, and internet speed assessments, so participants should be ready for those. Camera requirements and training length are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Selling Partner Support Specialist → Senior Support Specialist → Team Lead or Subject Matter Expert → Seller Support Program Manager. This role builds escalation handling, e-commerce knowledge, and root cause research skills.
